title: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Reaches Critical Death Toll
subtitle: Health officials warn the virus is spreading faster than ever as they struggle to contain a rare strain.

summary.en: The death toll from an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has now surpassed 2,000 people. Confirmed infections have climbed to over 4,300, making this the fastest-growing outbreak on record. Health authorities are facing significant challenges due to violence and poor infrastructure in the region. Currently, there are no approved vaccines for the specific strain of the virus causing this emergency. Officials are working to test potential treatments while trying to stop the further spread of the disease.
summary.zh: 剛果民主共和國的伊波拉疫情死亡人數已超過兩千人。確診感染人數攀升至四千三百人以上，使其成為史上擴散速度最快的疫情。衛生當局因該地區的暴力衝突與基礎設施落後而面臨重大挑戰。目前，針對導致此次緊急狀況的特定病毒株，尚無核准的疫苗可用。官員們正致力於測試潛在治療方法，同時設法阻止疾病進一步擴散。

paragraphs.en: A serious health crisis is unfolding in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where an Ebola outbreak has now caused more than 2,000 deaths. According to Al Jazeera English, the number of confirmed infections has reached over 4,300. This situation is becoming increasingly urgent as the virus continues to move quickly through the east and northeast parts of the country.
paragraphs.zh: 剛果民主共和國（Democratic Republic of Congo, DRC）正陷入一場嚴重的健康危機，伊波拉病毒疫情已造成超過兩千人死亡。根據半島電視台英語頻道（Al Jazeera English）報導，確診感染人數已突破四千三百人。隨著病毒持續在該國東部與東北部迅速蔓延，情勢正變得日益緊迫。

paragraphs.en: Deutsche Welle (DW) Top reports that this is the 17th time the DRC has dealt with an Ebola outbreak. Health experts are particularly worried because this specific event involves a rare and strong version of the virus known as the Bundibugyo strain. While there are vaccines for other types of Ebola, there are currently no approved vaccines for this specific strain. This makes the work of medical teams much harder as they try to control the spread.
paragraphs.zh: 德國之聲（Deutsche Welle, DW）報導指出，這是剛果民主共和國第十七次面對伊波拉疫情。衛生專家特別擔憂，因為此次事件涉及一種罕見且強力的病毒變異株，稱為邦迪布焦（Bundibugyo）病毒株。雖然針對其他類型的伊波拉病毒已有疫苗，但目前尚無核准的疫苗可用於對抗此特定病毒株，這使得醫療團隊在試圖控制疫情擴散時面臨極大困難。

paragraphs.en: The speed of this outbreak is alarming to international observers. Deutsche Welle (DW) Top notes that the number of deaths has doubled in just three weeks. Compared to the major West African outbreak that occurred between 2014 and 2016, this current situation has a higher mortality rate—the percentage of people who die after catching the disease. Experts believe the virus is spreading faster than health workers can track it, leading to fears that this could become the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 此次疫情的擴散速度令國際觀察家感到震驚。德國之聲指出，死亡人數在短短三週內就翻了一倍。與二零一四年至二零一六年間發生在西非的大規模疫情相比，目前的疫情致死率（即感染後死亡的人數比例）更高。專家認為病毒傳播的速度已超越衛生工作者的追蹤能力，令人擔憂這可能成為史上最嚴重的伊波拉疫情。

paragraphs.en: Health authorities are facing many difficult obstacles in their efforts to stop the virus. According to Deutsche Welle (DW) Top, the security situation in the region is unstable. Fighting and violence have made it dangerous for medical staff to work, and poor road conditions make it hard to reach affected areas. Additionally, strikes by healthcare workers and a lack of pay have created further problems for the medical response. Because of these issues, many people have been forced to leave their homes, moving into neighboring areas like Rwanda and South Sudan.
paragraphs.zh: 衛生當局在遏止病毒的努力中面臨許多艱鉅障礙。根據德國之聲報導，該地區的安全局勢不穩定。戰亂與暴力使得醫護人員的工作環境充滿危險，而惡劣的道路狀況也讓醫療物資難以送達受災地區。此外，醫護人員的罷工與薪資問題也為醫療應對工作帶來更多阻礙。由於這些問題，許多民眾被迫離開家園，逃往盧安達與南蘇丹等鄰近地區。

paragraphs.en: To help manage the crisis, the DRC government has introduced new rules, such as limiting public gatherings and closing the airport in Ituri Province, which is currently the center of the outbreak. Despite these efforts, officials admit that they are struggling to keep up. A regional director for health authorities recently told reporters that they are effectively "chasing the virus," noting that the disease is currently moving faster than their response efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 為了協助控制危機，剛果民主共和國政府已實施新規定，例如限制公眾集會，並關閉目前疫情中心伊圖里省（Ituri Province）的機場。儘管採取了這些措施，官員們坦言仍難以跟上疫情發展。一位衛生當局的區域負責人近日告訴記者，他們實際上是在「追趕病毒」，並指出目前疾病擴散的速度已超過了他們的應對措施。

paragraphs.en: There is some hope regarding potential treatments. Clinical trials for two antiviral methods—medicines used to treat viral infections—have been ongoing since early July. Furthermore, health officials are considering a full-scale human trial for the Ervebo vaccine. While this vaccine has been effective against other types of Ebola in the past, its success against the current Bundibugyo strain is not yet proven. The global vaccine alliance, Gavi, has made 500,000 doses of the vaccine available for these trials to see if it can provide protection to those at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 在潛在治療方法方面出現了一些希望。針對兩種抗病毒療法（用於治療病毒感染的藥物）的臨床試驗自七月初以來便持續進行中。此外，衛生官員正考慮對「艾爾維波（Ervebo）」疫苗進行全面的人體試驗。雖然該疫苗過去對其他類型的伊波拉病毒有效，但其對目前的邦迪布焦病毒株是否有效尚未獲得證實。全球疫苗免疫聯盟（Gavi）已提供五十萬劑疫苗供試驗使用，以觀察是否能為高風險族群提供保護。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the DRC Health Minister, Samuel Roger Kamba, stated that the country has not yet reached the worst point of the outbreak. In an interview, he expressed hope that the spread of the virus could be brought under control and begin to decline within the next three months. However, the situation remains fluid. Researchers have observed that this version of the virus seems to have changed since it was last seen in 2007 and 2012, and they believe it was transmitted from animals to humans.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，剛果民主共和國衛生部長山繆·羅傑·坎巴（Samuel Roger Kamba）表示，該國尚未達到疫情最嚴重的階段。他在受訪時表達了希望，認為病毒擴散能在未來三個月內受到控制並開始減緩。然而，情況依然變幻莫測。研究人員觀察到，此版本的病毒似乎自二零零七年與二零一二年上次出現以來已發生變異，且他們認為病毒是從動物傳播給人類的。

paragraphs.en: MedPage Today confirmed that the death toll has passed the 2,000 mark, emphasizing that this is the fastest-growing outbreak on record. As the international community watches the situation closely, the primary focus remains on improving healthcare access and finding a way to protect the population from this dangerous disease. The combination of medical research and local safety measures will be essential in the coming weeks to prevent further loss of life.
paragraphs.zh: 醫學新聞網站 MedPage Today 確認死亡人數已突破兩千大關，並強調這是史上擴散速度最快的疫情。隨著國際社會密切關注局勢，首要重點仍是改善醫療資源的可近性，並尋找保護民眾免受此危險疾病侵害的方法。醫學研究與在地安全措施的結合，將是未來幾週防止更多生命損失的關鍵。

keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（摺疊），這裡指事件正在發生。文中：A serious health crisis is unfolding in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where an Ebola outbreak has now caused more than 2,000 deaths.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To move or progress at the same speed as something else.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指醫療團隊的應對速度趕不上病毒擴散的速度。文中：Despite these efforts, officials admit that they are struggling to keep up.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Likely to change; not settled or fixed.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（流體），這裡形容局勢尚未定案。文中：However, the situation remains fluid.

quiz.question: According to the article, why is the current Ebola outbreak particularly challenging for medical teams compared to previous ones?

options.A: The death toll has already reached the highest level in history.
options.B: The specific strain of the virus currently spreading has no approved vaccine.
options.C: There is a complete lack of international support and medical supplies.
options.D: The virus is primarily spreading through the air rather than physical contact.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，文中明確提到這波疫情涉及一種罕見且強力的 Bundibugyo 病毒株，且目前沒有針對此特定病毒株的核准疫苗，這使得醫療團隊的工作更加困難。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章僅提到這可能是史上最快擴散的疫情，尚未說是史上死亡人數最高的。選項 C 錯誤，文中並未提到缺乏國際支援，而是提到醫療團隊面臨安全與交通等障礙。選項 D 屬於無中生有的資訊，文章並未提及傳播途徑為空氣傳播。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of the regional security situation on the Ebola response?

options.A: It has successfully encouraged more healthcare workers to join the front lines.
options.B: It has led to the complete eradication of the virus in neighboring countries.
options.C: It acts as a significant barrier that prevents medical aid from reaching those in need.
options.D: It has forced the government to prioritize economic growth over disease control.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，文章指出該地區安全局勢不穩、暴力衝突頻發且道路狀況惡劣，這些因素使得醫療人員難以進入受影響地區，這暗示了安全問題直接阻礙了救援工作的進行。選項 A 與文意相反，衝突反而導致醫療人員罷工與工作困難。選項 B 錯誤，文中提到民眾因恐懼逃往鄰國，並未提到病毒已被消滅。選項 D 並未在文中提及，屬於過度推論。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the phrase 'chasing the virus' imply about the health authorities' efforts?

options.A: They are proactively eliminating the virus before it spreads.
options.B: They are consistently one step behind the virus's rapid movement.
options.C: They are successfully tracking the virus to its original source.
options.D: They are focusing their resources on gathering more data about the virus.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文中提到官員承認他們正在「追趕病毒」（chasing the virus），並緊接著解釋疾病目前的擴散速度比他們的應對措施還要快，這意味著醫療當局總是落後於病毒的傳播速度。選項 A 與文中提到的「落後」意涵相反。選項 C 雖提到追蹤，但重點在於應對速度而非尋找源頭。選項 D 雖有提到研究，但該片語強調的是應對措施的無力感，而非單純的資料收集。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the central message of the article?

options.A: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is a minor issue that will be resolved within weeks.
options.B: The primary cause of the current Ebola crisis is the lack of international funding.
options.C: The DRC is successfully managing the outbreak through strict government regulations.
options.D: The DRC is struggling to contain a rapidly spreading, difficult-to-treat Ebola outbreak due to various complex challenges.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。這篇文章全面探討了剛果民主共和國（DRC）爆發的伊波拉疫情，涵蓋了病毒株的特殊性、擴散速度的嚴重性、安全與後勤障礙，以及政府與醫療單位的應對困境，這總結了全文的核心內容。選項 A 與事實不符，疫情非常嚴重。選項 B 錯誤，文中並未將資金不足列為主要原因，而是強調安全、交通與病毒特性。選項 C 錯誤，文中提到官員承認他們在應對上感到吃力，並非「成功管理」。
